name: CodeBuddys Delivery Availability Checker
author: codebuddys

sections.description:
CodeBuddys Delivery Availability Checker is a fast, lightweight, and modern WordPress & WooCommerce plugin that lets your customers check delivery availability and estimated transit times by entering their 6-digit Indian PIN code.

Key Features:

  • All-India Coverage: Pre-packaged postal code dataset covering all 28 States and 8 Union Territories in India.
  • One-Click Seeder: Instantly populate standard Indian pincodes with default delivery days and COD settings.
  • High-Performance Custom DB Table: Dedicated indexed MySQL table ensures sub-millisecond lookup latency.
  • WooCommerce Single Product Integration: Sleek, modern pincode checker widget placed below Add to Cart.
  • Shortcode Support: Place the checker anywhere with [idpc_pincode_checker].
  • Dynamic Delivery Date Calculation: Automatically calculates and shows expected delivery dates (e.g. Delivery by Friday, 28 Aug).
  • Cash on Delivery (COD) Status: Clearly informs shoppers if COD is supported in their area.
  • Persistent Memory: Remembers the customer’s pincode across product pages using cookies/localStorage.
  • Bulk CSV Import & Export: Upload carrier serviceability files from Delhivery, Shiprocket, BlueDart, Ecom Express, Shadowfax, or India Post.
  • Admin Dashboard & Management: Add, edit, filter, search, and bulk delete serviceable pincodes.
  • Customizable UI: Change button colors, badges, and custom success/failure text.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codebuddys-delivery-availability-checker folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory (or zip it and upload via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Pincode Checker > Database Tools and click Seed All India Pincodes (or upload your custom carrier CSV).
  4. Configure options in Pincode Checker > Settings.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

No! While it deeply integrates into WooCommerce single product pages, you can also use the shortcode [idpc_pincode_checker] on any page, post, or builder (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg).

How do I import my courier partner’s pincodes?

Navigate to Pincode Checker > Import / Export CSV, download our sample template, fill in your pincodes, and upload the CSV file.
